title: Nashville Children's Theatre

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: We believe in producing professional theatrical experiences for everyone. Your crowd-pleasing family theatre experience starts here. Give your students a memorable theatre experience, a fun field trip, and important life lessons all in one day. Did you know NCT is the oldest children’s theatre in the country? We’ve been bringing professional theatre to young audiences for nearly a century, and we’ve collected some great stories along the way. For 90 years and counting, we’ve helped audiences of all ages build empathy, think critically, and connect to the world through performances, classes, and community
